nodes.natural_language: What is the largest number $c$ such that $2x^2+5x+c=0$ has at least one real solution? Express your answer as a common fraction. Show that it is \frac{25}{8}.
nodes.statement: What is the largest number $c$ such that $2x^2+5x+c=0$ has at least one real solution? Express your answer as a common fraction. Show that it is \frac{25}{8}.
